name: io.github.WYRE-AI/cisco-umbrella-mcp
title: Cisco Umbrella
description: MCP server for Cisco Umbrella's deployment, admin, policy, reporting, and investigate APIs.

environmentVariables.name: CISCOUMBRELLA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Cisco Umbrella API Key, from Admin > API Keys (or Console Settings > API Keys for Multi-org/MSP) in the Umbrella admin console.

environmentVariables.name: CISCOUMBRELLA_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Cisco Umbrella API Secret paired with the API Key. Shown only once at creation and cannot be retrieved later.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
